audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart gives all seven stages to Poppy except a Skill at level 6, against a 57.2% Camille win rate over 243 games - the most favoured matchup in this slice. It also contradicts almost every string on its own page: spikes[0] 'you out-DPS Poppy in short trades', spikes[2] 'force every trade here', mid 'this is your window', and whys[1] through whys[5] all describe Camille winning levels 2 through first item.
audit.why: 57.2% is a decisively favoured lane and the prose agrees; only the win[] rows disagree. I could not propose the flip because 'Poppy' is 5 characters and 'Camille' is 7, which is outside the applier's +/-10% length band for those fields.
audit.corrected: Left every row untouched rather than half-fix it, and raised it in questionsForUser. It needs a hand edit or mirror-fix.js.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Bait her W before you ever use E' is the discipline the whole matchup rests on, and Steadfast Presence's cooldown never appears. Nor does any other Poppy cooldown.
audit.why: Steadfast Presence is 20/18/16/14/12s - the longest basic ability in the lane by a distance, which is exactly why baiting it buys you a genuine window rather than a moment. Hammer Shock 8/7/6/5/4s, Heroic Charge 14/13/12/11/10s, Keeper's Verdict 140/120/100s.
audit.corrected: spikes[3].text, early, mid and wants.you[1] now carry Steadfast Presence's 20s and Heroic Charge's 14s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two errors and one missing interaction. (1) 'Her delayed Q knockup', in four places - Hammer Shock creates a slowing zone that explodes after a delay. There is no knock-up in it; the knock-up threat is Heroic Charge into a wall and Keeper's Verdict. (2) 'Faster than Steadfast Presence sustains' - Steadfast Presence gives armour and magic resist and stops dashes; it heals nothing, so there is no sustain to out-race. (3) Keeper's Verdict is a CHANNEL, and your Hookshot's landing knock-up cancels it outright - the single most valuable thing Camille can do against Poppy, and it is nowhere on the page.
audit.why: Riot, Hammer Shock: 'Poppy swings her hammer, dealing damage and creating a zone that will slow enemies and explode after a delay.' Steadfast Presence: 'Poppy passively gains Armor and Magic Resist... Poppy can activate Steadfast Presence to gain Move Speed and stop enemy dashes.' Keeper's Verdict: 'Poppy channels a hammer strike that knocks enemies very far away.' _missing-interactions.json flags channel-interruptible for this pairing: 'Poppy's Keeper's Verdict (R) is a channel — your Hookshot (E) cancels it outright.'
audit.corrected: early, whys[0], spikes[3].text and wants.foe[1] drop the invented Q knock-up; spikes[2].text and whys[5] stop crediting Steadfast Presence with sustain; late and wants.foe[2] add the Hookshot cancel on the Keeper's Verdict channel.

edits.before: Respect level 1 — you have only Q and no all-in, and Poppy's delayed Q knockup plus passive zoning means stepping up early just feeds her poke. The trap of this lane is your E: Poppy's W (Steadfast Presence) is built to block dashes, so if you Hookshot in while she has W up, she slows and negates the dash and you eat a Q knockup for nothing. From level 2-3, trade with Q's true-damage recast and W's outer edge instead — walk up, don't dash in — and your DPS plus self-heal simply beats her base kit.

edits.before: This is your window. From 3 to 6 you out-trade her with Q-recast burst and W's max-HP slash that also heals you, and your passive shield eats her Q poke when you commit. The key discipline: bait her W before you ever use E — once that anti-dash is down your engage is free, or just skip E entirely and beat her with autos, Q, and W's outer edge. At 6, R walls her into your arena so she can't body-block her own ult or charge you into terrain with E, turning the isolated 1v1 fully in your favor.
edits.after: This is your window. From 3 to 6 you out-trade her with Q-recast burst and W's max-HP slash that also heals you, and your passive shield eats her poke when you commit. At 6, R walls her into your arena so she can't body-block her own ult or charge you into terrain with Heroic Charge.

edits.before: Your first-item bruiser/lethality spike plus W's percent-HP damage tears through her early tank build, so the mid-game is yours — dive, pick, and snowball before she's fully itemized. The danger late is her R (Keeper's Verdict): in skirmishes a well-timed knockback ejects you from your ultimatum or charges you off your dive entirely, and once she's full-tank she stops dying to a single combo. Close it out on your item lead rather than letting her scale into an unkillable peel-bot for her carries.
edits.after: Your first-item bruiser/lethality spike plus W's percent-HP damage tears through her early tank build, so the mid-game is yours — dive, pick, and snowball before she's fully itemized. Her R is the danger, but it is a CHANNEL: Keeper's Verdict has a wind-up, and your Hookshot landing knock-up cancels it outright, so hold E for that rather than spending it on the engage. Once she's full-tank she stops dying to one combo, so close it out on your item lead.

notes: TWO THINGS THE USER SHOULD SEE. First, the level chart hands all seven stages to Poppy in a 57.2% matchup while the page's own prose says Camille owns levels 2 through first item - the rows and the text are in flat contradiction and the win rate backs the text. I could not propose the flip: 'Poppy' (5 chars) to 'Camille' (7) is outside the applier's band for win[]/side fields, so it needs a hand fix or mirror-fix.js. Second, the best tool Camille has here was missing entirely: Keeper's Verdict is a channel and Hookshot's landing knock-up cancels it, which _missing-interactions.json flags explicitly. Also fixed: 'her delayed Q knockup' in four places (Hammer Shock is a slowing zone that explodes - no knock-up anywhere in it) and 'faster than Steadfast Presence sustains' (it grants resists and stops dashes; it does not heal).
